i.norm: Verifies that mergeAll() with a sparse array (null slots between two non-null Values) applies each non-null Value in order: the second Value (with merge=true) acts as an override on top of the first (with merge=false), producing a result equal to the second.
First Value: ignoreUnknown=true, allowGetters=true, allowSetters=false, merge=false merge=false means this Value does not participate in merging — it replaces base settings outright
Build a sparse array with nonMergeValue at index 0 and a fully-enabled Value at index 6; the five null slots in between are skipped by mergeAll
Second Value: all flags true, including merge=true
mergeAll iterates the array; nonMergeValue becomes the seed, then allEnabledValue (merge=true) is applied as an override — the merged outcome should equal allEnabledValue
